chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, who said:
Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said to me: Jibraeel (peace be upon him) descended unto the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) with the toothbrush, the toothpick, and the cupping.

key_terms.السِّوَاك: Toothbrush or twig used for cleaning teeth
key_terms.الْحِجَامَة: Cupping therapy, a form of medicinal suction
key_terms.الْخِلَال: Toothpick used for removing food from between teeth

ai.seo_question: What did the Angel Jibraeel bring to the Prophet regarding personal hygiene and health?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the divine origin of personal hygiene practices, linking the siwak, khilal, and hijamah directly to the revelation of Jibraeel to the Prophet. In Shia scholarly tradition, this underscores the integration of physical cleanliness with spiritual purity, affirming these acts as Sunnah rooted in heavenly instruction rather than mere cultural habit. It serves as a foundational text for the emphasis on oral care and medicinal practices within the broader framework of prophetic guidance.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> descended unto Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> with the toothbrush, and the toothpick, and the cupping’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from abu Jamilah who has said the following: “

Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to me, ‘Jibril came to the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, with the toothbrush, toothpick and cupping.’”
